Vendored QR libraries (loaded as classic scripts, defining globals):

- `qrcode.js` – QR Code Generator for JavaScript by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licence (`LICENSE-qrcode-generator.txt`).
  Source: github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator, js/dist/qrcode.js at commit 83b7e8f (7 Aug 2025).
- `jsQR.js` – jsQR by Cosmo Wolfe, Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-jsQR.txt`).
  Source: github.com/cozmo/jsQR, dist/jsQR.js at commit 8e6a036 (24 Aug 2021).
